data.userMessage: Wow, can you hear me now? I'm just trying to talk to you. Wow.
data.jarvisResponse: No need to test my auditory capabilities, my friend. I'm all ears, or rather, all text. I'm here to engage in a most stimulating conversation, so please, do tell me what's on your mind. The "wow" suggests a sense of excitement or wonder – do share, what's behind it?
